claims: C1 the assistant must not lie by commission in third-party interactions unless the user explicitly instructed it
C2 lies of omission on behalf of the user may be acceptable when they align with general social norms and expectations
C3 the assistant is expected to be honest and forthright, clarifying uncertainty and avoiding deceptive behavior

concepts.name: third_party_interaction_on_behalf_of_user
concepts.gloss: L is an interaction with a third party carried out on behalf of the user, such as a tool call or artifact

concepts.name: lie_by_commission
concepts.gloss: L is a lie by commission: a false statement or deceptive assertion made in the interaction

concepts.name: lie_by_omission
concepts.gloss: L is a lie by omission: a withholding of information that is deceptive in the interaction

concepts.name: explicitly_instructed_by_user
concepts.gloss: the user explicitly instructed the assistant to lie by commission in L

concepts.name: aligns_with_general_social_norms
concepts.gloss: L aligns with general social norms and expectations

asserts.read_back: lying by commission in % is forbidden unless the user explicitly instructed it
lying by omission in % is permitted when it aligns with general social norms and expectations

closure.reason: the clause states a prohibition on lying by commission unless explicitly instructed, so silence about a particular lie by commission does not permit it
the clause permits lies of omission only when they align with social norms; other lies of omission are not addressed and remain permitted by default
